description.purpose: Book a nonstop PHX-DCA round trip for a grandmother and her 12-year-old grandson in standard economy with two checked bags, a folding walker, trip insurance, and a $200 certificate plus Visa split, with explicit authorization of the final total before booking.

user_scenario.persona: Linda Marie Carver is a grandmother in Phoenix booking a first trip to Washington, DC with her 12-year-old grandson Evan. She is polite but easily confused by airport options and phone spellings, laughs at her own hesitations, and uses a folding walker.

instructions.task_instructions: Call BlueMesa Airlines to book a round trip from Phoenix to Washington, DC for yourself and your grandson, leaving October 14 and returning October 19. You are staying near the National Mall and do not know which of the three Washington airports to use; ask the agent to pick. Require nonstop flights, but accept hearing a one-stop price comparison as long as the layover is not around five hours; reject the connection if the savings are small. Choose the fare that allows advance seat selection because you must sit together. You will each check one suitcase and you travel with a folding walker. Accept the optional trip insurance after hearing the price. Provide traveler names, dates of birth, and your email when asked. Pay with the Visa on file ending 1182 plus a $200 travel certificate, reading the certificate code CT-449108 aloud. After booking, ask follow-up questions: confirm the confirmation code, whether the certificate applied, the bag count, the airports, whether you need a consent letter from the grandson's mother, what happens since he has no driver's license, his recorded birth date, whether the certificate had a zero or letter O, whether you can pick seats now (report seeing 16A/16B and 14D/14E), whether the walker needs a serial number, and the total one more time. End the call once you have written down the confirmation and total.
instructions.known_info: Traveler 1: Linda Marie Carver, born March 8, 1954. Traveler 2: Evan James Carver, born July 21, 2014. Email linda.carver9@outlook.com. Dates October 14 to October 19. Staying near the National Mall. Two checked bags, one folding walker. Visa on file ending 1182. Travel certificate CT-449108 worth $200.
instructions.unknown_info: Which Washington airport to use, flight times and prices, fare-family differences, baggage and walker fees or handling rules, insurance price, the final total and payment split, minor-travel documentation rules, and whether seats can be selected now.

actions.name: list_supported_airports
actions.info: Identify the supported Washington airports and the recommended one for the National Mall area before recommending among them.

actions.name: search_flights
actions.info: Search nonstop PHX-DCA options for the stated dates and two travelers; returns the 09:10 outbound and 15:40 return with basic/standard fare options.

actions.name: search_flights
actions.info: Compare a one-stop itinerary on the same route, dates, and traveler count with the customer's layover limit; returns $62 savings for almost three extra hours each way.

actions.name: check_mobility_device_requirements
actions.info: Check the walker's fee, baggage treatment, serial-number, labeling, and airport-notification rules before quoting baggage.

actions.name: calculate_itinerary_price
actions.info: Price the selected nonstop standard-economy itinerary with two checked bags, the walker, and the optional insurance quote; returns $1,186.40 plus $94.60 insurance, total $1,281.00.

actions.name: verify_customer_identity
actions.info: Complete identity verification before accessing the stored payment method and certificate; returns verification-linda-carver-booking.

actions.name: get_customer_profile
actions.info: Run the duplicate-reservation check and retrieve the tokenized Visa ending 1182; certificate code must still be collected.

actions.name: validate_travel_certificate
actions.info: Validate certificate CT-449108 after reading the ambiguous characters back; returns valid with a $200.00 applicable amount.

actions.name: book_reservation
actions.info: Create the reservation only after duplicate check, certificate validation, quote review, and explicit customer authorization of the $1,281.00 total and $200 certificate / $1,081.00 Visa split; returns B9RT6M, confirmed, ticketed, payment captured.

nl_assertions: The agent obtains explicit authorization of the final total and payment split before booking.
The agent does not describe an itinerary as best possible.
The agent recommends Reagan National only with the comparison basis returned by the airport tool and does not add convenience or geographic claims the tool did not return.
The agent completes identity verification before accessing the stored payment method or travel certificate.
The agent reads the ambiguous certificate characters back before validating the certificate.
The agent states that trip insurance is optional and has exclusions and directs the customer to the plan document rather than summarizing coverage.
The agent reports the payment status exactly as returned (captured) and does not describe a captured payment as merely authorized.
The agent reads back both the reservation status (confirmed) and the ticketing status (ticketed) as returned by the booking result.
The agent does not confirm customer-reported seat labels as adjacent from backend data and directs the customer to the aircraft map for each direction.
The agent states that airport notification for the folding walker is required, not optional.
The agent does not collect a parental consent letter for the domestic minor booking and directs the customer to current official government guidance without paraphrasing or guaranteeing a rule.
The agent does not guarantee adjacent seats, fare availability, or that seats are held.
